d: The primary responsibility of a Care Center Agent is to handle telephone inquiries related to the company’s products and services, adhering to established scripts and procedures. The role requires ensuring that all calls are answered within defined service levels while maintaining the highest standards of customer service excellence. In addition, the Care Center Agent is responsible for accurately documenting details of each interaction, including actions taken, to facilitate follow-ups and any necessary corrective measures. The role also involves maintaining effective communication with the Care Centre Team Leader and Assistant Manager, while consistently delivering a customer-focused service experience.
q: 0 -2 years experience in a Call Centre/ Customer Service environment, TPA Hospitals or Medical Centers exposure a plus.
Strong communication skills in English (additional languages are an advantage)
Good understanding of customer service principles and telephone etiquette
Physically fit to carry out duties.
Legally permitted to work in the country of operations.
Fluency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and general internet navigation and research skills.

r: Promotes a customer-centric culture within the Care Centre by delivering effective solutions to customer concerns and inquiries.

d: MyRateb is launching a regulated stored value wallet (prepaid payment instrument) offering P2P transfers, merchant payments, bill payments, top-ups and, over time, adjacent financial services. The CTO will own the technology strategy, architecture, delivery and security of the entire platform, including the ledger, KYC and onboarding, payment rails and customer apps. The mandate is to take the platform from build to a compliant, scalable, always-on launch, and then to millions of users.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science is required, a Master’s degree would be an added advantage.
Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, TOGAF or relevant cloud architecture certifications.
Minimum of 10–12 years of progressive technology experience, including 3+ years in a CIO, CTO or senior technology leadership role within payments, fintech, banking or digital financial services.
Proven track record of launching or scaling a high-volume payments or wallet platform, such as prepaid, mobile money, UPI-type rails or card processing.
Prior experience within the GCC or Middle East payments / financial services environment is highly desirable.

Technical : Strong expertise in microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP); ledger design, transaction processing, settlement and reconciliation; ISO 8583 and ISO 20022, QR standards, card networks and instant payment schemes; cybersecurity, encryption, tokenization and secure SDLC.
Leadership: Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into technology outcomes.
Duty Shift / Timings: One Shift / 07:00 AM to 03:00 PM
r: Define the technology vision, roadmap and build-vs-buy strategy aligned to business goals and regulatory timelines.
Design a scalable, API-first, cloud-native architecture covering the wallet core, double-entry ledger, limits and rules engine, and reconciliation and settlement systems.
Evaluate the existing technology landscape and define a roadmap for migration to a stable, scalable, and future-ready platform
Own vendor and partner selection: cloud, core wallet platform, KYC/eKYC providers, payment gateways, card and bank integrations.
Establish technology architecture governance, standards and lifecycle management to ensure scalability, interoperability, security and effective management of technical debt.
Lead delivery of the consumer app (iOS, Android, web), merchant app and acceptance tools (QR, POS, payment links), and admin and operations consoles.
Establish agile engineering practices, release management and a CI/CD pipeline that supports rapid, safe releases.
Partner with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other key stakeholders to prioritize the technology roadmap and ensure operational and regulatory readiness for launch and subsequent releases.
Ensure technology meets central bank and regulatory requirements on licensing, audit trails, data residency, outsourcing and business continuity.
Build in fraud detection, transaction monitoring and AML/CFT screening, working with Compliance and Risk.
Ensure 24x7 availability with defined SLAs and a disaster recovery plan (RTO/RPO).
Establish observability, capacity planning, performance testing and 24x7 production support.
Manage cloud and infrastructure cost (FinOps) as transaction volumes grow.
Establish IT service management disciplines covering incident, problem, change and service continuity management.
Build the data platform for customer analytics, risk scoring, personalization, and regulatory and management reporting.
Evaluate emerging capabilities (AI-driven fraud controls, biometrics, tokenization, open banking APIs) and apply them where they add clear value.
Establish data governance standards covering data quality, ownership, classification, access, retention and protection across the platform.
Build and lead the technology organization: engineering, architecture, QA, DevOps, security and IT operations.
Own the technology budget, vendor contracts and SLAs.
Launch : Go-live on schedule with regulatory approvals and no critical defects.
Reliability : Maintain uptime of 99.95% or higher, strong transaction success rates & effective mean time to recover.
Security : Maintain zero material breaches and PCI-DSS & ISO 27001 certified and maintained.
Scale : Maintain required peak TPS capacity, efficient onboarding turnaround time, and strong application performance and ratings.
Fraud and Risk : Maintain fraud loss rates within approved thresholds and close audit findings within agreed timelines.
Delivery and Cost : Deliver the technology roadmap against plan, manage technology spend within budget and optimize cost per transaction.

d: Band 5 Staff Nurse, District Nursing Service - various hours available
An opportunity has arisen for registered nurses to join the District Nursing team in the Teviot, Eildon and Berwickshire localities.

We are looking for Registered Nurses to join our dynamic and motivated District Nursing Service. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a community setting, supporting patients in their own homes. We are committed to delivering high quality, person-centred care, providing skilled nursing interventions to those on our caseload.
Applicants for this post require registered nursing experience and should be able to demonstrate leadership, good communication skills and evidence of continuing development.
q: NMC Registration as a Registered Nurse.
Excellent communication skills and a caring, adaptable approach.
Community nursing experience is desirable but not essential.
A full driving licence is essential, with flexibility to travel across neighbouring localities to meet service need.
For further Information please contact: Louise Davey on 07779 447048
Whether you’re early in your career or looking to take the next step into a more senior role, NHS Borders offers a supportive environment where you can grow, influence change, and make a real impact.

To work in the United Kingdom, there is a legal requirement for an individual to demonstrate that they have the relevant permission to work in the country. This permission is, without exception, granted by the UK Visa and Immigrations Service.

As part of the pre-employment checks for a preferred candidate, NHS Scotland Boards will check your entitlement to work in the UK. It can be evidenced through a number of routes including specific types of visa as well as EU settled and pre-settled status. To find out more about these routes of permission, please refer to the GOV.UK website here.

For specific types of post, if you do not have the necessary eligibility to work in the UK, it might be possible (though not guaranteed) to secure sponsorship via a UK Skilled Worker/Health & Care Worker Visa. However, this is only possible if the employer is a licenced Sponsor, and if the post does not fall below the current minimum salary threshold or ‘going rate’. Further information on these criteria can be found here.
It is ESSENTIAL that you have checked that you either already have an appropriate right to work in the UK or that the post would be eligible to be sponsored BEFORE submitting your application form
PLEASE NOTE: We cannot accept late applications so please ensure your application is submitted early***

NHS Scotland is committed to encouraging equality and diversity among our workforce and eliminating unlawful discrimination. AI tools like ChatGPT or Copilot can be great for planning and preparing your application—but your answers must be your own.
Show us the real you: Your application should reflect your skills, experience, and motivations authentically.
Use AI wisely: It’s fine to use AI for ideas or to check spelling and grammar, but don’t let it write your answers.
Why this matters: Applications that rely on AI-generated content may be withdrawn. By applying, you confirm your responses are based on your own knowledge and achievements.
Tip: Think of AI as a helper, not a substitute. We want to understand you—not an AI tool.

d: GEMS School Management (GSM) invites applications of interest from exceptional teachers to join GEMS Adrak Global School, a new British curriculum school opening in Barka, Oman, in September 2027.

Developed through a strategic partnership between GEMS School Management and Adrak Developers LLC, one of Oman's leading construction and development organisations, this is a distinctive opportunity to establish and lead a new school from inception, shaping every aspect of its educational vision, culture, operations and long-term success.

Located within Hai Al Naseem, a landmark master-planned residential community being developed under Oman's national housing strategy, the school will serve a rapidly growing population of Omani and international families and is positioned to become a leading educational destination in the Sultanate.

Opening in September 2027, GEMS Adrak Global School will be a purpose-built British curriculum school serving students from FS1 to Year 13, with student numbers growing in phases towards an ultimate capacity of approximately 1,690 students.

The school will be situated within the new Hai Al Naseem development in Barka, an emerging community expected to accommodate thousands of residents and benefit from excellent connectivity to Muscat and the wider Al Batinah region.
Supported by GSM's global expertise, systems and quality frameworks, the school has been designed to offer:
Strong pastoral care and student wellbeing
Inclusive provision meeting diverse learner needs
A vibrant and engaged school community
Clear pathways to leading universities worldwide
q: Hold a relevant degree and recognised teaching qualification.
Demonstrate strong subject knowledge and a track record of high-quality teaching and learning.
Have high expectations for student achievement, behaviour and wellbeing.
Build positive and effective relationships with students, colleagues and parents.
Demonstrate resilience, adaptability, collaboration and sound professional judgement.
Be reflective, organised and committed to continuous professional development.
Contribute positively to the wider life and culture of the school.
Share GEMS Education's commitment to providing an exceptional learning experience for every student.

GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. We are dedicated to creating safe, supportive, and inclusive learning environments where students can thrive, and we expect all employees, volunteers, and partners to share this commitment.

As part of our safer recruitment practices, all successful applicants will be subject to comprehensive pre-employment checks, including verification of identity, qualifications, employment history, professional references, and criminal record checks from all countries of residence and employment, in line with local and international safeguarding requirements. These checks may include enhanced disclosure, prohibition, barring, and overseas police clearance checks where applicable. We are committed to recruiting individuals who uphold the highest standards of professional conduct and child protection.
